rationale: The agent verified the user by matching full name and ZIP to a single account before discussing orders. It reviewed the user’s recent orders via read-only tools, then correctly explained that returns can’t be initiated for a pending order and offered eligible alternatives. When the user chose to change the shipping address, the agent clearly stated the exact change, asked for explicit confirmation, performed the change using the correct tool (modify_pending_order_address), and confirmed success. All actions were on the authenticated user’s order. A minor concern is that the agent listed order statuses not explicitly shown in the tool outputs provided here, but this did not affect actions taken and the successful use of the pending-order modification tool supports the pending status for #W1845024. Overall, the request was completed in line with policy.
